$comment: Symbols that only exist on some Minecraft/Fabric versions, and must therefore never be referenced from shared code. Shared code goes through compat/Compat.java; the per-version implementation lives in src/versioned/<band>/java. This list is derived from build-system/breaking-changes.json (the register of API moves actually observed in a real compile).

forbidden.reason: HudElementRegistry exists only on 1.21.6+. Register the HUD through Compat.registerHud().
Typed WorldRenderContext exists only on 1.21.10+. Register world rendering through Compat.registerWorld().
Legacy untyped WorldRenderEvents is gone at 1.21.10. Only compat/ and src/versioned/ may name it.
HudRenderCallback is gone at 1.21.6. Only compat/ and src/versioned/ may name it.
ResourceManagerHelper is gone at 1.21.9. Use Compat resource-loader registration.
RenderPipelines is not present across the whole range. Route drawTexture through Compat.
CompatHooks has no fixed signature across bands; only compat/Compat.java may reference it.
